title: Alignment Bridge: Initiative Deconfliction Matrix and Tactical Runway
creator: Ava Park
description: Problem: As multiple teams (Serving Runtime, Dedicated, Console, Research) plan parallel initiatives tied to company-level OKRs, we lack a lightweight mechanism to detect and resolve scope overlap, timing conflicts, and resource contention before quarterly planning. Scope: build an 'Alignment Bridge' playbook + lightweight tooling to capture initiative boundaries, external dependencies, and a tactical runway for the upcoming two quarters. Deliverables: 1) Deconfliction matrix template (CSV + Google Sheet) with lanes for owner, OKR tie, risk, required infra, and rollback policy; 2) Confluence playbook describing the mediation process and decision authority; 3) Roadmap tracker view in our internal roadmap tool with gating states (Concept, Committed, At-Risk, Blocked, On Track) and an automated weekly digest to stakeholders; 4) One cross-functional runbook and a recorded tabletop run to validate mediation steps. Success metrics: reduction in discovered cross-team blockers during planning from 28% -> <10% by Q2 close; average time to resolution for inter-team conflicts shortened to <48 hours; 85% of company-level initiatives classified with a tactical runway by due date.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Deconfliction matrix template published and used by at least 6 initiative leads in the next planning cycle; 2) Confluence playbook approved by GTM and Eng leadership; 3) Roadmap tracker view populated and producing weekly digests; 4) One mediation session completed and learnings documented; 5) Metrics dashboard showing classification coverage >= 85%.
